spaces.input.task.tipsForDescription.mod: A clear, engaging description helps you find the right helpers! Here are some tips:
Imagine explaining the task to a friend – this keeps the description natural and engaging.
Explain in 2–3 sentences what the task is about. Avoid long or complicated sentences.
Be as specific as possible: Need help collecting trash in the park is better than Looking for help with an environmental project.
Show the impact! For example: “With your help, our park will be cleaner!”
Write in a positive tone and address readers directly: “Want to join?” sounds more motivating than “We need people for this task.”

tracking.consentModal.manageOptions.adPa: Help us grow! In order to address people on external sites and networks (such as Facebook or Instagram) with holi advertising that are as suitable as possible, we analyse your usage behaviour and interactions with your consent and compare the hashed contact details you have entered with us (name and email address) with these networks.
